underlying_fred_series.GDP_YOY: FRED GDP (quarterly, nominal), year-over-year percent growth
underlying_fred_series.CLAIMS_YOY: FRED CCSA (Continued Claims, Insured Unemployment, weekly), year-over-year percent growth
underlying_fred_series.FEDFUNDS: FRED DFF (Federal Funds Effective Rate, daily), level in percent
underlying_fred_series.M2_YOY: FRED WM2NS (M2 money stock, weekly), year-over-year percent growth
underlying_fred_series.NASDAQ_YOY: NASDAQ composite daily closing price (vendor: investing.com, bundled in the Kaggle dataset), year-over-year percent change

resampling: Each raw series resampled to monthly (last observed value at or before each month-end); GDP additionally forward-filled across its own quarter (documented, not an unexplained gap-fill: GDP is only released quarterly).
publication_lag_note: A FIXED, documented assumption per series (not fetched real vintage data) -- e.g. GDP's first ('advance') estimate is released roughly a month after the quarter ends. Each month's value in the derived CSV is re-keyed to the first month-end at or after (its own period's month-end + this lag), so the value appearing for month M is honestly knowable by M's end.

sanity_checks.NASDAQ_YOY 2008-10: -39.8% (real NASDAQ crash trough, confirmed against known financial-crisis history)
sanity_checks.CLAIMS_YOY 2020-04: +339.1% (real COVID unemployment-claims spike, confirmed against known pandemic history)
